text:
maya.chen: Hey team — Cypress Health (acct: cypress-inc) hit sustained 429s from eu-west yesterday after their onboarding stress run. Customer flagged this as a potential renewal risk in ~30d if perf doesn't stabilize. Can we approve a short-term regional egress exemption + temporary rate-window bump while we finish routing and prefix caching fixes?

raj.patel: +1 on exemption. They're still in pilot and need ~1.8–2x QPS headroom for 48h to finish smoke/stress tests. AE asked for something quick we can toggle.

linh.tran: I can implement a policy change on routing and add a canary fallback to the smaller-quantized model to keep tail latency down. Need exact CIDRs and target regions for the allowlist/rate window.

maya.chen: CIDRs from customer: `203.0.113.0/24` and `198.51.100.0/28`. Regions: `eu-west-1`, `ap-southeast-1`. Proposal: bump multiplier to `2.0` for those regions for 48h, add those CIDRs to egress-exempt allowlist, and set `auto_revoke=true` at 48h. I'll log the renewal risk on the account and notify AE.

network-ops: Preflight started. We'll tag the flows and create a temporary egress exemption. Adding automated anomaly detection to revoke early if traffic pattern looks malicious. Control-plane commands we'll run: 
```
/ops allow-egress --account=cypress-inc --cidr=203.0.113.0/24,198.51.100.0/28 --regions=eu-west-1,ap-southeast-1 --duration=48h --auto-revoke
/ops set-rate-window --account=cypress-inc --multiplier=2.0 --regions=eu-west-1,ap-southeast-1 --duration=48h
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled: allowlist applied (job id: 98321), rate window created (rw-4839). Expires in 48h. Monitoring hooks attached. Job details: https://console.redwood/jobs/98321

linh_tran: Canary fallback deployed for the small-quant model in eu-west-1, cache pre-warm scheduled at 03:30 UTC (reduces cold-starts). I'll monitor p95/p99 latency for the next 6 hours and post updates.

maya.chen: Thanks — I'll message the customer with steps and ask them to re-run the stress tests. Please ask them to include a few sample request IDs if they see 429s so we can trace. Also adding notes to the renewal case: short-term quota increase granted; cost impact estimate attached.

raj.patel: Filing quick renewal note and cost delta for 48h bump. Also adding AE to the case for adoption sync.

maya.chen: One more — capture enablement feedback after the pilot via this form: https://forms.redwood/enablement/cypress-pilot-feedback. Will include link in the case.

network-ops: Done. Added a follow-up ticket to auto-revoke if anomalous spikes appear. :lock:

maya.chen: Excellent. Closing the loop here — I'll update the customer and mark CS case as "on temporary exemption". Ping me if anything odd shows up. :thumbsup:
